subject: Moderated mediation error: missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

messages.author: 57adfeaf6a74fec2
messages.subject: Moderated mediation error: missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
parts:
Hi,

I'm conducting a moderated- mediation (b-path) with categorical outcome. When I run the model with just the interaction-term, it works fine. However, when I try this including the moderator, I get an error message. Can someone help me?


model = '
mediator ~ a*X
Y ~ b1*mediator_cen +b2*moderator_cen +b3*interactionterm
Y ~ cp*X_cen
'
# run the model
modmed = sem(model, data = data, ordered=c("Y"), estimator = "DWLS")

#view the output
summary(modmed, standardized = T, fit.measures = T, rsquare = T)


> model= '
+ mediatior ~ a*X
+ Y ~ b1*mediator_cen +b2*moderator_cen +b3*interactionterm
+ Y ~ cp*X_cen
+ '
> # run the model
> modmed = sem(model, data = data, ordered=c("Y"), estimator = "DWLS")
Error in if (!all(x == cache$theta)) { : 
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

KR. Angela

messages.author: 12fdd832cacb825e
messages.subject: Re: Moderated mediation error: missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
parts:
I don't know if this is the core problem, but you probably want to use mediator_cen in the first line, not mediator. Same for X. I doubt the model as written is what you're expecting it to be.

Pat
